program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((nz (find-first (lambda (rc) (!= (at g (fst rc) (snd rc)) 0))
                                  (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                             (map (lambda (c) (cons r c)) (range 0 w)))
                                           (range 0 h))))
                  (br (fst nz))
                  (bc (snd nz))
                  (tl (at g br bc))
                  (tr (at g br (+ bc 1)))
                  (bl (at g (+ br 1) bc))
                  (brr (at g (+ br 1) (+ bc 1))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (let ((v v))
                        (if (!= v 0)
                            v
                            (cond
                              ((and
                                 (> r (+ br 1))
                                 (> c (+ bc 1))
                                 (<= r (+ br 3))
                                 (<= c (+ bc 3))) tl)
                              ((and
                                 (> r (+ br 1))
                                 (< c bc)
                                 (<= r (+ br 3))
                                 (>= c (- bc 2))) tr)
                              ((and
                                 (< r br)
                                 (> c (+ bc 1))
                                 (>= r (- br 2))
                                 (<= c (+ bc 3))) bl)
                              ((and (< r br) (< c bc) (>= r (- br 2)) (>= c (- bc 2))) brr)
                              (else 0)))))))))
